The EE-P2X lane imports C4 layer 1 (ee_p2x_darwin_stage_backend.py:713 from rawlsing_next.pre553_physical_decoder import decode_dta, decode_sav; fiabc_final_oracle_freeze_producers.py:1247; pre553_carrier_execution.py:58 imports C4 layer 2). ee_p2x_process_isolated_backend.reasoning: rawlsing_next/ee_p2x_process_isolated_backend.py has ZERO static importers anywhere in the repository. Its INNER_BACKEND_DEFAULT string at :18 is resolved only by importlib.import_module inside ee_p2x_darwin_court_driver.py:863, which is reached only from the driver CLI at :1263 when invoked with --backend-module. It then reaches ee_p2x_darwin_stage_backend only by subprocess.Popen into a sealed child process (ee_p2x_candidate_process_envelope.py:717-736 -> :437 -> :386). That is the EE-P2X measured lane.

blast_radius_of_both_gates.statement: Both gates live in exactly two files, neither of which is in the C4 closure. Neither gate is referenced by any test, and neither is referenced from WORKER_RETURNS except the two preflight shell scripts that invoke verify_runtime_gate directly.

consequence: No EE-P2X Darwin gate patch or waiver is required for the C4 path, exactly as HQ's adjudication stated. C4C3 qualified the actual C4 path on the Darwin/x86_64 anchor without touching either gate.

adjacent_finding_not_a_gate.statement: This line RECORDS pyreadstat.__version__ into the reader_configuration of every PhysicalSourceIncidence. It performs no comparison and is not a gate.
adjacent_finding_not_a_gate.why_it_still_matters: closed35_g01_sav_numeric_representation_authority.py and tests/test_r35_i01_physical_metadata.py treat reader_config['reader_version'] as identity-bearing, and DTA-3 in 04_SYNTHETIC_READER_PROBES.json measures that the physical-metadata digest CHANGES with the reader lane. So the installed pyreadstat version and the reader lane are evidence-bearing even though they are not gates. PHASE 3 and PHASE 6 freeze both.
